candidates.snippet: A Russian pro-Kremlin media outlet has confirmed that yet another general has kicked the bucket. This is already the second commander of the 4th Separate Motorized Rifle Brigade to drop dead on Ukrainian soil. The first one croaked near Bakhmut in 2023. https://t.co/Wgv2v5ufQI ht

Russian channels report that another general has been killed in the war. Russian sources published an obituary for Anton Felixovich Grunis, identified by the Exilenova+ channel as a Major General in the Russian Armed Forces and commander of the 4th Separate Motorized Rifle https:

Bild reports that drone debris was found in Germany near the Wunstorf military airfield. The wreckage was discovered in an uninhabited area east of Lake Steinhuder Meer, approximately one kilometer from the Bundeswehr airfield. No debris was found on the territory of the military
